race.description: Inglis Ready2race Sale 15 Oct C,G & E (Bm72) Hcp
race.comment: CLANCY (7) tackled the mile for the first time with a narrow fourth after shouldering the 58.5kg at this track and trip third up. Was three weeks between runs on that occasion and looks set to peak. FIERCENESS (8) has a tidy win record and has gone to a new level this campaign. Nailed a solid field right on the line to make it two wins from his last three outings after saluting over 1550m at Canterbury. Drawn out for this and can get cover in a fast run race. FEAR NO EVIL (4) comes up from Victoria deep into the prep and can take control early. Failed to run the 1800m from the wide gate when fourth at Caulfield in BM74 grade. Worth another chance. DUBAI WARRIOR (6) relished the weight drop with a tough nose victory in the Tuncurry Cup over 1600m. Has to cope with the steep weight rise and place prospects look best.
